upload_intents_target_ck.name: upload_intents_target_ck
upload_intents_target_ck.value: ("upload_intents"."kind" = 'CREATOR_PHOTO' AND "upload_intents"."creator_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("upload_intents"."kind" <> 'CREATOR_PHOTO' AND "upload_intents"."pitch_id" IS NOT NULL)

workflow_events_reject_reason_ck.name: workflow_events_reject_reason_ck
workflow_events_reject_reason_ck.value:
"workflow_events"."action" <> 'REJECT' OR (
    "workflow_events"."rejection_category_key" IS NOT NULL AND "workflow_events"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL
    AND char_length(btrim("workflow_events"."rejection_reason")) >= 10)
